description: A fine soft cotton or linen cloth used as a flexible backing for maps, plates, and split paper. It is pinned flat and pasted so a folded sheet gains a hinge and resists tearing.
name: jaconet

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter III, p.53. Internet Archive.
